---
title: "Opening Admin"
---

Admin holds the shop's to-do list: paperwork waiting to be verified, hand
checks waiting for a second look, and changes to review. Only managers can
open it, and it asks for proof each time.

## Before you start

- You've [picked your name](signing-in.qmd).
- You have a passkey set up on your phone, or an Admin PIN.

## Steps

1. Tap **Admin**.
2. Tap **Use my passkey** and follow your phone, or type your PIN and tap
   **Open with PIN**.

   ![Admin asking for a passkey or PIN](/screenshots/manager/admin-door.png)

3. *(Steps to come.)*

::: {.callout-note}
## When you're done
Tap **Lock Admin**. It also locks by itself after 30 minutes.
:::
